summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution to dispose of 51,952 common and some preferred treasury shares for stock compensation to independent non-executive directors and executives. The disposal price per common share is KRW 100,000, with an estimated aggregate value of KRW 5.2 billion, to occur OTC via SK Securities from April 28 to May 31, 2026. This is a routine employee compensation transaction, not a special situation. No special situation applies.
